column1: # Phase 5d: which frozen legacy semantic facts the modern ZK CE 10 slice must
# The Phase 5d modern capture runs the same flow as the frozen legacy browser
# oracle - login, role selection, desktop/menu, read-only "Error Message" window,
# logout - against /webui-modern on Tomcat 10.1 instead of /webui on Tomcat 9.
# Its facts are compared with semantic-facts.tsv at matching capture ordinals.
# Not every frozen fact is comparable, and pretending otherwise would be the same
# mistake the four filter-* facts were nearly used to make. This file records the
# reviewed decision per fact, and ModernWindowExtraction.comparable() fails if a
# capture produces no value for a fact marked `compare`, so a fact cannot quietly

column3: The role selection grid renders the same four ADempiere labels (Role, Client, Organization, Warehouse) in both renderings.
The desktop identity line is produced by ADempiere from the authenticated session, not by the UI framework.
The menu tree is built from the application dictionary, so the same role must see the same "User Browser" node.
The core Phase 5d Testability Milestone claim: the window opens and renders.
The tab label is the AD_Window name from the dictionary.
The read-only column set is derived by ADempiere's WEditor from the dictionary, not by ZK.
The full field-state marker map, for the same reason.
The toolbar state is derived by CWindowToolbar from AD_Tab and role access.
The destructive-control half of the read-only claim.
The zero-write half of the read-only claim, measured against the same marker-owned database by the same script.
Logout must return the browser to the login page in both renderings.
/adempiere is a Tomcat 9 context. The Phase 5d modern runtime deploys /webui-modern and /ADInterface only, so there is nothing to compare. Phase 5f owns the non-ZK contexts.
/mobile is a Tomcat 9 context; see filter-adempiere.
/webui is the ZK 3.6 context itself. The modern slice is /webui-modern by design, and Tomcat 9 remains the only browser-facing ingress through Phase 5h.
/wstore is a Tomcat 9 context; see filter-adempiere.
